title: RetransmitIter is dead code with potential arithmetic underflow
description:
Line 1051-1075: `RetransmitIter` is defined but never constructed or used anywhere in the codebase.

The struct contains a potential arithmetic underflow at line 1067:
```rust
let rel_pos = abs_pos - self.start;
```
If `self.start > abs_pos`, this would panic in debug or wrap in release.

Since the code is unused, this is not currently exploitable, but it could surface if someone starts using it.

Suggested fix: Either remove the dead code entirely, or add a bounds check:
```rust
let rel_pos = abs_pos.checked_sub(self.start)?;
```
